limitations: Small sequential cohorts, network/time effects uncontrolled. No P95/P99 or <2% conclusion.
Listener resource counters are process-wide and include normal reconciliation; no per-operation CPU attribution.

CDP CPU/task/heap and long tasks are document-wide; no per-operation CPU attribution or physical device/concurrent-user benchmark. Network sizes cover completed browser API requests, not MQTT/callback traffic. Database write volume needs separate history inspection.
